description: Client-side script for handling the 'Bank Statement Import' form in Frappe/ERPNext, managing import progress, status, warnings, logs, and UI interactions.

classes.name: frappe.data_import.ImportPreview
classes.description: Class used for rendering and managing the import preview UI component.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes event handlers and UI configurations when the form is loaded.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form UI, updates buttons and indicators based on current document state.

methods.name: onload_post_render
methods.description: Triggers actions after the form is rendered on load.

methods.name: update_primary_action
methods.description: Sets the primary action button based on form state and import status.

methods.name: update_indicators
methods.description: Updates the status indicator on the form.

methods.name: show_import_status
methods.description: Displays a summary message of import success or failure.

methods.name: show_report_error_button
methods.description: Adds a button to report errors if the import status is 'Error'.

methods.name: start_import
methods.description: Initiates the import process via server call.

methods.name: download_template
methods.description: Downloads a template for bank transactions.

methods.name: reference_doctype
methods.description: Handles changes to the reference doctype field.

methods.name: toggle_submit_after_import
methods.description: Shows or hides the submit after import option based on doctype properties.

methods.name: google_sheets_url
methods.description: Handles updates to the Google Sheets URL field.

methods.name: refresh_google_sheet
methods.description: Refreshes the import preview when Google Sheets URL is updated.

methods.name: import_file
methods.description: Loads and previews the import file or Google Sheets data.

methods.name: show_import_preview
methods.description: Displays the import preview data in the UI.

methods.name: export_errored_rows
methods.description: Exports rows with errors to a template file.

methods.name: show_import_warnings
methods.description: Displays warnings related to the import data.

methods.name: show_import_log
methods.description: Displays detailed import logs with success/failure messages.
